candidate_relations.reason: Sarcoma is a competing soft-tissue malignancy, not extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma.
Myeloproliferative neoplasm is a different marrow disorder and peripheral-blood flow cytometry was unremarkable.
Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease is a different self-limited lymphadenitis, not ENKTL.
Pyomyositis was the initial treatment target and did not improve; it is not the lymphoma.
Rheumatoid arthritis is not supported as the cause of atypical dermal infiltrates and B symptoms.
Polymyositis describes the gastrocnemius myositis presentation rather than the extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma.
Infection was presumed (cellulitis/pyomyositis) and is a different entity from ENKTL.
Langerhans cell sarcoma is a different hematologic malignancy.
Cellulitis was the admitting diagnosis and is incompatible with atypical dermal mononuclear cells unresponsive to antibiotics.
Panniculitis describes the subcutis involvement pattern, not the lymphoma diagnosis.
Immune-mediated disorder is a nonspecific alternative, not ENKTL.
Castleman disease does not account for the atypical dermal infiltrate and calf myofascial disease.
Systemic lupus erythematosus is a different systemic autoimmune disease.
Leukemia is a related hematologic malignancy of incompatible lineage/presentation relative to extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma.
Inflammatory myofascial disease names the MRI pattern rather than the lymphoma.

case_quality_flags: No complete_equivalent candidate; extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type is not named
The supplied record stops at atypical dermal mononuclear cells without lineage immunophenotype
